title: Easy Roasted Chinese Egg White Dan Dan Mian
description: A quick-fix Chinese dish featuring roasted egg white, namul-blanch-season, and keto-friendly ingredients, formed into dan-dan-mian, a type of Chinese noodle dish. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, whisk together egg whites, sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, and garlic until well combined.
Pour the egg mixture into a baking dish and roast in the oven for 12 minutes or until the egg whites are set and lightly browned.
While the egg whites are roasting, cook the namul according to package instructions and season with salt and pepper.
Once the egg whites are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Slice the roasted egg whites into thin strips and serve on top of the namul, garnished with chopped scallions.
Garnish with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
